root_text:
A 2-month-old baby admitted to Orange Hospital in Chandkheda, Ahmedabad, tested positive for human metapneumovirus (HMPV) on December 26th, but the hospital failed to report the case to the Ahmedabad Municipal Corporation.

#HMPV #Ahmedabad
